scope: Six visual gulls. Authored flights, not a wildlife population model.
rights: Original procedural meshes and materials. References supply species facts only. No external image, mesh, texture, recording, or animation is copied.
placement_limits: Offshore gaps are checked against the approximate source shoreline and park boundary. Live collision queries and rider images must still pass. These are authored flight areas, not bird survey locations.
acceptance: Original meshes imported and static rest pose inspected. V2 moves the true-scale gulls closer and improves runtime motion. V2 live appearance, collision telemetry and cost remain pending.
